svg.title: 1955 clock run · vehicle turnaround
svg.desc: Two views of the first-film conversion. The left shows the nose-north car and its twin banks of charging coils. The cutaway on the right shows the low wedge, gull-wing door, instrument stack and exposed power equipment.

g.text: Reaction chamber and paired vents on rear deck
Blank fascia and plate / first-film clock-run rig
